title: MSME & Entrepreneurship Support Schemes
description: National, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh government schemes, corporations, and support bodies for MSMEs and entrepreneurs.
scope_note: Covers schemes/bodies as entities, not individual beneficiary businesses.

provenance.collection_method: WebSearch-based knowledge engineering research. Direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.nic.in domains was blocked by this session's organizational egress policy (confirmed HTTP 403, live-tested immediately before collection began). Every fact is a cited search result; none fabricated. Numeric investment-range figures required a specific citable government project-profile source or were left PENDING_VERIFICATION.
provenance.confidence_calibration_note: Government-project-profile-grade sources scored 70-85; portal/blog-only estimates capped at 58-65; no row exceeds 85 since no direct fetch was possible this session.
